summary: n8n Vulnerable to Remote Code Execution via Expression Injection
facts: Authenticated users who can configure workflows can supply expressions that execute in an insufficiently isolated runtime context.
The vulnerable Tournament configuration has an empty before-hook list, so regular function expressions are not rebound away from the Node.js global context.
The selected direct-child fix adds FunctionThisSanitizer to the before-hook list and rewrites function expressions to use an empty controlled context.

provenance.commit_role_basis: official advisory references the selected fix; local Git confirms it is a direct child of the candidate commit and adds FunctionThisSanitizer

summary: n8n Vulnerable to Unauthenticated File Access via Improper Webhook Request Handling
facts: Certain publicly reachable form workflows can expose files from the n8n host to an unauthenticated remote attacker.
The vulnerable form return path consumes request body file objects without first requiring multipart/form-data, allowing a JSON body to supply attacker-controlled file paths.
The selected direct-child fix asserts multipart/form-data before prepareFormReturnItem processes body data and files.

provenance.commit_role_basis: local Git confirms the selected fix is a direct child of the candidate commit; its diff adds the multipart/form-data assertion described by the advisory

summary: n8n has OS Command Injection in Git Node
facts: Authenticated users who can create or modify workflows can abuse the Git node to execute arbitrary system commands or read arbitrary files.
The vulnerable add operation forwards comma-split user paths to simple-git without a double-dash option separator, so a path beginning with a hyphen can be interpreted as a Git option.
The selected direct-child fix trims paths and inserts the double-dash separator before add and commit path arguments.

provenance.commit_role_basis: local Git confirms the selected hardening commit is a direct child of the candidate commit; its diff adds the option separator described by the candidate

summary: OpenClaw gateway connect could skip device identity checks when auth.token was present but not yet validated
facts: The gateway WebSocket connect handshake can skip device identity checks based on the presence of a non-empty auth.token rather than a validated shared-secret result.
In affected Tailscale-reachable configurations, a client can connect without device identity or pairing and may obtain operator access.
The selected fix makes device-identity skipping require validated token or password authentication.

provenance.commit_role_basis: official advisory names the fix commit; local Git confirms it is a direct child of the candidate commit

summary: OpenClaw Node host system.run rawCommand/command mismatch can bypass allowlist and approvals
facts: In node-host system.run, allowlist and approval evaluation can inspect rawCommand while command[] supplies a different argv for execution.
Affected allowlist deployments can therefore approve an allowed rawCommand but execute a different command[] value.
The selected direct-child fix enforces rawCommand and command[] consistency at the gateway and node host.

provenance.commit_role_basis: official advisory names the fix commit; local Git confirms it is a direct child of the candidate commit
